xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4312: Conversation open stalls behind polling aggregates on the read worker lane; duplicate transcript loads on open

plan.title: Conversation open stalls behind polling aggregates on the read worker lane; duplicate transcript loads on open
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Opening a conversation can hold the transcript skeleton for seconds. The WebSocket stream's first payload waits for getConversationByName (0-1 ms of work) on the one-slot read worker lane, which also runs polling aggregates of up to 34 s (search stats p50 13.4 s, cost snapshot ~1.2 s every 15 s); in one boot it waited >1 s 9 times, p50 11.5 s, max 17.6 s. Every open also repeats transcript work: a duplicate HTTP /messages load for live conversations, synchronous computeContextUsage re-parses (30-300 ms per call), an uncached full-file claude-initial parse, and /diffs spawning two git processes per edited turn every 5 s, even for ended conversations.
narratives.Proposal: Move the four polling aggregates to a new poll lane so read serves point lookups only; make search stats cheap by reading lastIndexedAt from file_cursors; derive /messages context usage from its parse and memoize computeContextUsage; after the lane split, turn the HTTP /messages read for streaming conversations into a 1500 ms fallback (resume/switch-model/fork completion re-read via fetchQuery) and drop the dead cancelQueries calls; reuse the claude-initial snapshot through sharedTranscriptParser with per-subscriber parse-state copies; make /diffs poll only live conversations, run one diff pair per repo, and cache results for 30 s. Document the lanes and the open sequence.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The hard-load burst (~60 parallel REST calls and a 5.35 MB getSnapshot frame before the skeleton)
- Windowing or tail-first initial payloads
- The background main-thread load (40-60% of a core, p99 event-loop lag at rest)
- Sharing one pane read across getConversationRead's permission, pane-choice and input-target checks (investigation fix 7)
- Removing GET side effects (updateConversationCost in /messages, permission-registry pruning in getConversationRead)
- Reverting PAN-3752 to resolve the subscribe row synchronously (contingency only if post-deploy verification fails)
- Changes to SimpleActivityFeed or useSubagentTranscript
- Changing MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS_PER_LANE or adding concurrency to any lane
- An index or schema migration on the embeddings DB

autoDecisions.summary: Add a fifth worker lane named poll instead of reusing long.
autoDecisions.rationale: long runs costReconcileSweep/scanConversations/enrich/embed for minutes; a 15 s cost snapshot behind them would exceed its 5-minute maxAgeMs and start failing routes. One extra worker thread is accepted.

autoDecisions.summary: All four polling aggregates share the single poll lane, as the issue specifies.
autoDecisions.rationale: The only interactive consumer is the conversation list's cold ledger read at boot, which is no worse than today; search-stats-cursor cuts the long job from ~9 s to <300 ms.

autoDecisions.summary: Search stats read lastIndexedAt from max(file_cursors.updated_at WHERE byte_offset > 0); count(*) and the per-refresh open stay.
autoDecisions.rationale: Measured read-only on the live 3.07 GB DB at load 16.6: max(indexed_at) 9005 ms, count(*) 290 ms (covering index), cursor max 0.4 ms, open+sqlite-vec 3 ms. An index would cost a one-time ~9 s scan at open plus per-upsert write cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Memoize inside computeContextUsage keyed by (sessionFile, model) and validated by size+mtimeMs, 16 entries.
autoDecisions.rationale: Covers getConversationRead without editing it; same effect as the issue's getConversationRead memo.

autoDecisions.summary: HTTP fallback delay is 1500 ms, implemented in a new hook file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue proposes ~1.5 s; a separate file keeps ConversationPanel.tsx under its 1531-line allowlist row.

autoDecisions.summary: Resume, switch-model and fork completion re-read /messages with queryClient.fetchQuery({ ..., staleTime: 0 }) instead of invalidateQueries.
autoDecisions.rationale: invalidateQueries does not refetch a disabled query, and those events are when the stream may still watch an old session file; fetchQuery preserves today's HTTP refresh but still honors staleTime, so without staleTime: 0 it is a no-op whenever a recent stream event left the query fresh under the app's default 30s staleTime.

autoDecisions.summary: The claude-initial snapshot shares sharedTranscriptParser's existing cache and budget, with per-subscriber copies of parse-state containers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Concurrent requests already coalesce via COALESCED_OPERATIONS; the incremental parser mutates priorState maps/sets in place, so copies are required for correctness.

autoDecisions.summary: Diffs cache key is (conversation name, sessionFile, size, mtimeMs) with a 30 s TTL; repo HEAD is not in the key.
autoDecisions.rationale: git diff <base> -- <paths> compares against the working tree, so HEAD does not decide the result; the TTL bounds staleness from outside edits.

autoDecisions.summary: Live latency targets (30-minute slow-log window, p90 open at load 20, 150 ms warm /messages) are post-deploy verification in the PRD, not item ACs.
autoDecisions.rationale: They need the deployed dashboard; item ACs are unit tests plus one Playwright UAT the test role can run on the branch.

autoDecisions.summary: OKF knowledge pages are updated inside docs-architecture and committed in the separate overdeck-knowledge repo.
autoDecisions.rationale: A commit in that repo cannot carry the Item: trailer pan task done checks on the feature branch; the DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md commit carries it.

autoDecisions.summary: Investigation fix 7 (shared pane reads) and the GET side effects stay out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Fix list names six fixes and omits them; they are minor and independent.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept that opening a streaming conversation no longer calls updateConversationCost.
autoDecisions.rationale: The list prefers ledger cost (conversation-list.ts line 265); the write was an undesired GET side effect.

metadata.acJustification: Five criteria: reuse, coalescing, the missing-file path, container isolation, and the ws-rpc call-site/ratchet check are separate failure modes of one change.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7 and Decision 7. (1) src/dashboard/server/services/shared-transcript-parser.ts: add 'claude-initial' to `type Parser`; add exported parseStateFromSnapshot(initial: ParseResult): ParseState that copies pendingToolUse, unresolvedResults (new Map), planToolUseIds, countedUsageIds, orphanToolUseIds (new Set) and fileEditsByAssistantId (new Map with copied arrays), and carries the scalar fields; mirror the field list of the priorState literal at ws-rpc.ts lines 190-203 and the optionality in conversation/types.ts. The incremental parser mutates these containers in place (parser.ts lines 258, 268, 323, 371, 424, 434), so sharing without copies corrupts other subscribers. Also in sharedTranscriptParser: when `await stat(sessionFile)` throws with code 'ENOENT', dispatch runDashboardDbJob<ParseResult>('parseTranscriptSnapshot', { sessionFile, parser }) WITHOUT creating a cache entry and return its result (the worker parser already returns an empty result for a missing file and watchConversation then polls; a freshly spawned Claude conversation subscribes before its transcript exists). Rethrow other stat errors. (2) src/dashboard/server/ws-rpc.ts streamClaudeTranscript (lines 168-247): module-level `const claudeInitialSnapshot = sharedTranscriptParser('claude-initial');`, replace the runDashboardDbJob('parseTranscriptSnapshot', { sessionFile, parser: 'claude-initial' }) call with `await claudeInitialSnapshot(sessionFile)`, and replace the priorState literal with parseStateFromSnapshot(initial). Remove imports this leaves unused. ws-rpc.ts must not grow past 1219 lines (last allowlist row). (3) Tests in src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/shared-transcript-parser.test.ts.

In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-diffs.ts getConversationDiffs (lines 149-222): group each turn's edits by repo once (groupFilesByRepo per turn, remember turn -> repo -> paths), build the per-repo union of paths, resolve baseCommit once per repo (existing baseCommitCache), run ONE diffFilesSinceBase(repoRoot, baseCommit, union) or diffFilesAgainstHead(repoRoot, union) per repo inside the existing per-repo try/catch, index the result by path, then emit per-turn summaries in fileEditsByAssistantId order with the same turnId/completedAt/status/assistantMessageId fields, pushing only when files.length > 0. narrative.Action: PRD WI-9 and Decision 8. In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-diffs.ts add a module-level Map keyed by `${conv.name}\0${sessionFile}` holding { size, mtimeMs, at, body }, capped at 32 entries (evict oldest insertion). After resolving sessionFile, await stat() from node:fs/promises (never a sync call); return the cached body when size and mtimeMs match and Date.now() - at < DIFFS_CACHE_TTL_MS (30000); otherwise compute, store the { summaries } body, return it.
